method: Copies of an archive that a compute job can read as a whole, kept apart from curated ML benchmarks. For data mining and pretraining the archive is the intended population, so this table asks how much of that population is reachable. Values as stated on the source page, read through a page summary on 2026-11-06 unless noted; computed marks sums. Regridded stores can exceed the raw archive in bytes, so a byte ratio is not a coverage fraction. Not searched: GNSS, OOI, DAS, hydrology, InSAR, Sentinel-1.
